quotes.quote: Too many are being priced out of the California Dream. Housing, groceries, gas, insurance, healthcare continue to rise, while government red tape delays housing and discourages investment.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As Lieutenant Governor, I will make higher education more affordable, expand paid internships, and strengthen career pathways.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Voters elected me to four public offices where I focus on accountability, transparency, fixing broken systems, cutting waste, and delivering results.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As State Treasurer, I financed a record number of affordable housing units, expanded down-payment assistance for first-time homebuyers, saved distressed hospitals, and attracted investments that created good-paying jobs.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Reckless policies have made food, gas, housing, and energy unaffordable for ALL of us.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I will restore education standards, develop a bold economic plan that helps businesses thrive, rein in politicized commissions that have failed to protect our water, farmland, and way of life, defend Title IX for our daughters in sports, and fight antisemitism on our campuses.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: California’s budget is bloated with bureaucracy and waste. For years, one-party rule has failed us.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As Secretary of State, I pledge to speed up vote counting, secure our elections, and remove the chief elections officer from partisan politics.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As California's Chief Elections Officer, I will ensure every eligible voter's right to participate in our democracy, every legitimate vote is counted, and every Californian can trust the result, no matter who wins.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Thirty-six states and most democratic nations require photo ID at the polls. California does not, leaving our election security so weak at least one dog was registered and voted twice!
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I will be an umpire for fair elections, not a partisan player.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Some of them have even threatened the lives of election officials when their preferred candidate loses. This behavior will not be tolerated in California.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I will continue to fight to make sure that nothing stands between you and the ballot box.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: And I've been a transparent leader because trust is everything.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As Controller, Malia has strengthened fiscal transparency by expanding public access to financial and payroll data, giving Californians a clear view of how public dollars are spent.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: She has released timely monthly cash reports to help keep California fiscally strong during economic uncertainty, reunited all 58 counties with millions in unclaimed property, and honored local governments for excellence in accurate financial reporting.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: The Controller is tasked with ensuring efficiency in state government through pre-audits and approval of expenditures, followed by rigorous post-audits that verify performance and proper use of funds.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I will deliver for the people by placing all expenditures in an easy-to-use online database with transaction-level detail and near real-time reporting, so every Californian can see exactly how public funds are used.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As Treasurer, I will ask the tough questions others won’t, insist on measurable results, and work to expose waste, fraud, and mismanagement wherever they exist.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I will advocate for responsible investing, greater accountability, and honest stewardship of the public’s money.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As Treasurer, I will build more affordable housing through public finance; invest in the financial future of children and families, defend health care and immigrant communities, and protect pensions for hard-working Californians.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I’m running for state Treasurer to responsibly manage California’s finances, strengthen our economy, and make smart investments that create opportunity.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Californians voted for Prop. 36 overwhelmingly to restore accountability for repeat theft and drug offenses. I will fully enforce it and will prosecute the traffickers poisoning our communities, protect victims, help people off the streets and into treatment, and make sure your tax dollars are spent honestly and effectively.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Safe streets and equal justice belong to every community, whatever your zip code or last name.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Public safety is not a partisan issue, and I will never treat it like one.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: That’s why I authored laws requiring insurers to increase upfront payments for claims, creating low-interest loans for home improvements that reduce fire risk, and helping homeowners keep their coverage when they fix hazards on their property.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As Insurance Commissioner, I’ll increase competition to bring down costs, protect consumers who are unfairly dropped, make insurers accountable and the process transparent, and expedite rebuilding.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: After a disaster, Californians deserve fast and fair treatment when they’re trying to rebuild.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I’ve passed laws holding polluters accountable and investing in wildfire prevention, water infrastructure, and resilience, while meeting our clean energy goals and protecting our water, coast, and ocean.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I’m not taking any insurance company money because my loyalty is to you.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I’ll make claims fast and fair, cap excessive profits, and crack down on illegal price-fixing.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I’ll ensure our premiums are invested into making our communities safer through a public Disaster Insurance for All program.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: I’ll hold them accountable to make insurance more affordable and available and make sure our money works for us.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: The Insurance Commissioner should be working for you to lower prices, not working for the industry to increase profits. That’s why I will never take a dime from insurance companies.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Democrat Richard Barrera led the reform effort that transformed San Diego Unified from a district in crisis to one that is First in Reading and Math among the nation’s largest urban districts.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: An 18-year veteran of the San Diego Unified School Board (and current President), Barrera brought parents, educators and the community together to cut waste/bureaucracy and invest in students and the classroom.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: Barrera led four successful campaigns to repair 60-year-old schools, upgrade technology, and improve school safety with electronic door locks, single points-of-entry and updated emergency communication for neighborhood and charter schools.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: California’s public schools are failing our children. Fewer than half can read or write at grade level.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: My plan is simple: restore high academic standards in reading, writing, and math; protect Title IX, ensuring fairness and safety for girls; cut wasteful bureaucracy; and demand fiscal transparency to ensure money reaches classrooms where it belongs, supporting our students and our great teachers.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide

quotes.quote: As State Superintendent, I will bring that same leadership statewide as an advocate for students and families, standing up to politicians and special interests to protect the office’s independence as voters intended.
quotes.sourceTitle: Official candidate statement, California Secretary of State voter guide
